problem: Loop return temp alarm at 37°F, duty circ pump stopped
outcome: Return temp back to 42°F; duty pump returned to service next day

problem: Chlorine low at 0.4 mg/L after weekend, day tank level unchanged
steps_taken: Opened bleed valve on hypochlorite pump
outcome: Chlorine 1.0 mg/L; cause was loss of prime

problem: Short filter runs and turbidity 0.28 NTU during spring breakup
steps_taken: Increased turbidity checks to every 4 hours
outcome: Turbidity held between 0.10 and 0.22 NTU through breakup

problem: Raw water pump 1 would not start, breaker tripped
steps_taken: Switched to standby raw water pump
outcome: Pump 1 ran normally after reset; no repeat

problem: pH up to 8.1 after new soda ash batch
Filter 2 turbidity 0.31 NTU after only 30 hours of run time
Filter 2 turbidity high again, 0.34 NTU, short run
outcome: Turbidity down to 0.15 NTU after second backwash

problem: Filter 2 turbidity 0.36 NTU, third time in 30 days; some sand seen in backwash waste
outcome: Running on filter 1; RMW scheduled to inspect filter 2 media and underdrain
